sentences.l2: 人打哈欠时，嘴巴张很大。
sentences.l1: When people yawn, their mouths open very wide.

sentences.l2: 这和身体的生物学有关。
sentences.l1: This has to do with the body's biology.

sentences.l2: 大脑温度高的时候，人想打哈欠。
sentences.l1: When the brain's temperature is high, people want to yawn.

sentences.l2: 哈欠能让大脑变凉一点。
sentences.l1: A yawn can make the brain a little cooler.

sentences.l2: 神经学研究发现，打哈欠和大脑的功能有关系。
sentences.l1: Neurological research has found that yawning is related to the brain's functions.

sentences.l2: 有时候，别人打哈欠，你也会想打。
sentences.l1: Sometimes, when someone else yawns, you will want to yawn too.

sentences.l2: 你看别人打哈欠，你的身体就跟着做。
sentences.l1: When you see someone else yawn, your body just follows along.
